base: 16:9 landscape scene for a family-friendly Hindi cartoon set in Gulmohar Mohalla, a small Indian neighbourhood with narrow lanes, colourful houses with flat roofs and orange-flowered gulmohar trees; flat 2D cartoon, thick bold black outlines, warm colours, flat cel shading. NIGHT scenes use a deep blue-black night palette with moonlight or warm lantern light, but every face is clearly lit and easy to read. NEVER scary: no ghost, no monster, no skull, no scary or hidden-horror face, no blood. The 'white figure' is always just a person wrapped in a plain white woollen shawl, and its face is never shown unless the prompt says so. Mitthu is a bird: he only flies, perches, flaps and talks - he never holds anything and has no hands. No text, signs, letters or numbers anywhere.

scenes.prompt: Night, wide view across the lane towards Sharma ji's two-storey house (as in the location reference: narrow outdoor stairs up to a flat roof, red iron gate below), under a big full moon and many stars. On the flat roof a tall figure completely wrapped in a plain white shawl walks slowly, seen small, far away and from behind - no face visible; soft and mysterious, not scary. A white bedsheet hangs on a clothesline on the same roof. Dark blue night, one faint warm window.

Night, inside Dadi's small mud house with a clay-tile roof (as in the location reference), no electricity, dark blue room lit by moonlight: on the RIGHT, {golu} sits on the sill of a small open wooden window, sweaty, a round hand fan in one hand, pointing outside with the other, scared and excited; {mitthu} perches on the window frame right next to his shoulder with puffed-up feathers, staring out. On the LEFT, {dadi} lies on a charpai under a thin sheet, half asleep, calmly waving one hand as if saying 'go to sleep'. Through the window, far away, a moonlit row of flat roofs. All three faces clearly lit.

Bright morning in the lane in front of Sharma ji's red iron gate and an orange gulmohar tree: {gupta} talks dramatically with wide eyes, one hand raised high to show 'this tall'; {sharma} hugs a rolled-up mattress to his chest, scared; {pandey} stands with his hands on his hips, listening with a doubtful frown.

Morning in the same lane: {pandey} puffs out his chest, holding a long wooden lathi upright like a hero, chin up, boastful; next to him {golu} seriously holds out a small steel plate of yellow laddoos; {mitthu} perches on the red iron gate with his beak wide open, excited.

Night at the bottom of the narrow outdoor concrete stairs that lead up to Sharma ji's flat roof (as in the location reference): {pandey} stands on the first step holding his lathi, knees knocking, sweat drops flying, looking up the dark stairs with a forced brave face. Dark blue night, moonlight on his face.

Night, Mrs. Gupta's pink two-storey house with a balcony (as in the location reference), with EVERY window and the balcony lit bright yellow, glowing against the dark blue lane; {gupta} at the front door hurriedly pulling the door shut, holding the handle, worried face, glancing back over her shoulder.

Night, inside Dadi's small mud house: {golu} has jumped into {dadi}'s arms and hugs her tightly with his eyes squeezed shut; Dadi sits up on her charpai, calm, holding him; {mitthu} flaps his wings wildly on the window frame, a few green feathers in the air. Moonlight lights their faces.

Night in the lane near Sharma ji's house: {dadi} holds up a glowing old brass lantern in one hand and her wooden walking stick in the other, calm and determined; {golu} hides half behind her saree, peeking out, scared but curious. Warm lantern light on both faces against the dark blue night.

Night, at the top of the narrow outdoor stairs, at the edge of the flat roof (as in the location reference): warm lantern light (an old brass lantern held up by a hand in a light-green saree sleeve, entering from the bottom-left corner) falls on a tall figure wrapped in a plain white woollen shawl who is slowly turning around. We see only the back of the shawl and one shoulder; the head is covered by the shawl and the face is turned away, completely hidden. Stars above. Mysterious, gentle, not scary.

Night on the flat roof in warm lantern light: big close-up of {mishra} (face and shoulders, the white shawl around him), gentle, a little sad and lonely, with a soft polite smile and kind eyes; starry sky behind him. On the left {dadi} holds up the brass lantern and looks at him kindly; {golu} peeks out from behind Dadi.

Night on the flat roof under a sky full of stars: {golu} and {mishra} sit side by side on a mat, both pointing up at the sky together - Golu excited, Mishra dada smiling warmly; the seven bright stars of the Saptarishi (Big Dipper) shine clearly in the sky; {mitthu} perches on the roof railing beside them.

Early evening on Mishra dada's flat roof in warm golden dusk light: neighbours sit on mats with glasses of chai and a big plate of pakoras. {mishra} in the middle, smiling happily; {gupta} offers him the plate of pakoras; {pandey} hides his lathi behind his back and scratches his head sheepishly; {sharma} laughs; {dadi} and {golu} sit together nearby; {mitthu} perches on the railing, beak open happily. No other people.

Night on the same flat roof under a sky full of stars: {dadi}, {golu} and {mishra} sit on a mat around a small glowing lantern, all laughing together; {mitthu} perches on the railing next to Golu. Exactly these four, no other people. Keep the group in the LEFT 60% of the image; the right side is open starry sky over the rooftops. Warm, cosy and happy.
